drivingQuestion: What ruling does the Tzaidan incident illustrate?
outcomeNote: answered in the next unit (חסורי מיחסרא)

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי בְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה: מַעֲשֶׂה בְּצַיְדָּן וְכוּ׳: מַאי תַּנָּא דְּקָתָנֵי מַעֲשֶׂה?
segments.en: «Rabbi Yosei, son of Rabbi Yehuda, said:» There was «an incident in Tzaidan» involving one man who said to his wife: It is konam if I do not divorce you, and he divorced her; and the Sages permitted him to remarry her, for the betterment of the world. «What» did the mishna «teach that» causes Rabbi Yosei, son of Rabbi Yehuda to «teach» this «incident?» The mishna had just discussed a case where the woman took a vow, and it relates an incident where the man took a vow.
